inlines.v: EMPA'LEMENT, noun A fencing, fortifying or inclosing with stakes; a putting to death by thrusting a stake into the body. 1. In botany, the calyx or flower-cup of a plant, which surrounds the fructification, like a fence of pales. 2. In heraldry, a conjunction of coats of arms, pale-wise.
